TITLE: Chat
FADE_TIP: Lines fade this long after they come, while the cursor is off the chat. 0: they never fade.
WHISPER_TABS_TIP: Each whisper partner gets a tab. Off, whispers show in General.
REPEATS_TIP: The same player's same words one after another show once, with ×N.
KEPT_TIP: The last lines of each tab come back after a reload, dimmed. 0: none.
HELD_TIP: Older lines go once a tab holds this many.
PLAIN_ARROWS_TIP: Off, the arrows bring back what you sent, as Alt+arrows do.
